dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, how many countries have you visited?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈkʌntriz hæv juː ˈvɪzɪtɪd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Twelve, I think. Look at all the stamps in my passport!
dialogue.reading: ˈtwɛlv, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. ˈlʊk ət ˈɔːl ðə ˈstæmps ɪn maɪ ˈpæspɔːrt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow! How many continents have you been to?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ! ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈkɑːntɪnənts hæv juː bɪn ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Three: North America, Europe and Asia.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː: ˈnɔːrθ əˈmɛrɪkə, ˈjʊrəp ənd ˈeɪʒə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How many times have you crossed a border by bus?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈtaɪmz hæv juː ˈkrɔːst ə ˈbɔːrdər baɪ ˈbʌs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Several times. I've crossed the border into Malaysia twice.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɛvrəl ˈtaɪmz. aɪv ˈkrɔːst ðə ˈbɔːrdər ˈɪntuː məˈleɪʒə ˈtwaɪs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, but the line at immigration was very long. How many times have you been abroad?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, bʌt ðə ˈlaɪn ət ˌɪməˈɡreɪʃən wʌz ˈvɛri ˈlɔːŋ. ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈtaɪmz hæv juː bɪn əˈbrɔːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only once, to Japan. My passport is almost new!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ˈwʌns, tə dʒəˈpæn. maɪ ˈpæspɔːrt ɪz ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈnuː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then let's go to Laos together. You need more stamps!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ tə ˈlaʊs təˈɡɛðər. juː ˈniːd ˈmɔːr ˈstæmps!
